findings.statement: Total income rose 5.8% to RMB124.9bn in FY2025 (FY2024: RMB118.1bn); insurance revenue rose 1.7% to RMB103.1bn; total assets were RMB527.8bn at end-2025.
Net profit attributable to shareholders fell 7.4% to RMB9.77bn (FY2024: RMB10.56bn) and weighted average ROE fell from 10.74% to 9.18%.
Before inter-segment eliminations, FY2025 insurance revenue was RMB48.9bn primary P&C, RMB45.8bn P&C reinsurance and RMB10.1bn life and health reinsurance.

Underwriting moved in opposite directions: the overseas P&C and Chaucer combined ratio improved (84.71% to 81.19%) while domestic P&C reinsurance (92.77% to 95.98%) and primary P&C (97.67% to 99.17%; 100.41% including insurance finance items) weakened, leaving primary P&C around break-even.
Group solvency ratios edged down: aggregated 194% to 189% and core 159% to 155% (end-2024 to end-2025; 2025 figures unaudited).
Central Huijin (controlling shareholder, 71.56%) and the Ministry of Finance (11.45%) together hold 83.01% of shares (sum of the two disclosed stakes).
Disclosed FY2025 pressure points: lower domestic agriculture earned premiums, H1 catastrophe losses overseas, and a lower total investment yield (4.83% to 4.66%).

claims.statement: China Re is majority state-owned: Central Huijin is the controlling shareholder (71.56%) and the Ministry of Finance holds 11.45%.
FY2025 earnings softened despite top-line growth: total income +5.8% but attributable net profit −7.4% and ROE down 1.56 percentage points.
claims.caveats: Two years only; drivers of the profit decline are not decomposed here.

claims.statement: Overseas P&C underwriting strengthened while domestic P&C reinsurance and primary P&C margins narrowed.
claims.caveats: Segment-level ratios only; no group-level combined ratio recorded.

claims.statement: Group solvency eased slightly in 2025 to 155% core and 189% aggregated.
claims.caveats: 2025 solvency figures are unaudited. Regulatory minimums are not yet sourced in this record.

claims.statement: The issuer reports its A.M. Best "A (Excellent)" and S&P "A" ratings were maintained in 2025.
claims.caveats: Issuer-reported; agency publications, rating types, dates and outlooks not yet reviewed.

claims.statement: Primary P&C insurance and P&C reinsurance are of similar size and together dominate insurance revenue; life and health reinsurance is much smaller.
claims.caveats: Segment figures are before inter-segment eliminations.

gaps.description: No revenue split by country or region was found in the two sources reviewed. The full FY2025 annual report has not been reviewed.
gaps.impact: A geographic exhibit cannot be built yet. Do not allocate overseas business to countries.
gaps.suggested_action: Review the FY2025 annual report segment and geographic notes.

gaps.description: No group-level combined ratio was found in the results announcement; only segment ratios are recorded.
gaps.suggested_action: Check the annual report; otherwise present segment ratios with their scopes.

gaps.description: Ratings are issuer-reported only. Agency rating type, action date, outlook and rationale have not been checked at A.M. Best or S&P.
gaps.suggested_action: Retrieve the latest rating action from each agency.

gaps.description: Regulatory minimum solvency requirements (C-ROSS) are not sourced, so the headroom above minimum is not stated.
gaps.suggested_action: Cite the NFRA solvency rules for core and comprehensive minimums.

gaps.description: The record shows who controls China Re, not whether or how the state would support it; no source on support willingness or capacity has been reviewed.
gaps.suggested_action: Review rating agency support assessments (e.g. government-related issuer analysis).

gaps.description: The issuer's principal risk and risk-management disclosures have not been reviewed; the risks recorded are FY2025 performance pressure points only, and mitigants are not covered.
gaps.suggested_action: Review the annual report risk management section and any rating agency risk discussion.

gaps.description: The 31 December 2025 solvency figures are unaudited per the issuer.
gaps.suggested_action: Re-check against the audited or NFRA-published solvency report when available.
